ruleFamily.prediction: For each target round, predict the winning number equals the winner observed exactly lag rounds earlier.

multiplicity: Bonferroni across 20 frozen lags; per-candidate alpha = 0.0005.
promotionRequires: exactly first 5000 eligible future target rounds only
one-sided binomial p below Bonferroni alpha
observed hit rate above 1/30 economic break-even
Wilson 95% lower bound above 1/30 economic break-even
separate untouched replication before any real-money authorization
disclosurePolicy: Administrative progress only before the fixed boundary; per-lag hits, rates, rankings and p-values remain hidden.
